name: Thai Turkey Burger with Cucumber-Lettuce Salad, Spicy Mayo & Peanuts

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ limes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
Peel and mince ginger and shallot. Add both to the remaining bowl with the cilantro.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add turkey, bread crumbs, and fish sauce to the bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
½ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice limes into the reserved bowl with the cilantro. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Place mayo and hot sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Spread spicy mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
